name: kiwrap-vscode-shell
description: Prototype VS Code shell that hosts a remote KiCad display (iframe URL or canvas+WebSocket) and a keyboard/pointer event probe.

commands.title: kiwrap: Open live KiCad surface (3D viewer)
kiwrap: Write marker to probe log
kiwrap: Forward key to KiCad view (internal)

kiwrapShell.url.description: URL of the display backend page to iframe (noVNC / Xpra HTML5 / Broadway / own stream). Empty = built-in demo page served by the extension.

kiwrapShell.liveWs.description: WebSocket URL of a winstream helper (ws://127.0.0.1:8765/ws). When set, *.kicad_pcb / *.kicad_sch open as live KiCad surfaces (pcb / sch) fed by that helper.

kiwrapShell.wsUrl.description: WebSocket URL of a frame stream (canvas mode). Empty = built-in synthetic stream served by the extension.

kiwrapShell.logFile.description: Append every probe event here (JSONL). Empty = only the Output channel.

kiwrapShell.autoOpen.description: Open a panel automatically at startup (used by the automated test driver).

kiwrapShell.rescueKeys.description: When true, the contributed keybindings (Ctrl+W, Ctrl+P, ... while the KiCad view is active) are swallowed and forwarded to the webview instead of running the VS Code command.
